race.comment: ALWAYS SPEEDY (7) won again in another strong performance to make it back to back wins, scoring by (17.03) at this track over 300m. In top form and looks a key chance again. THERMAL IGNITION (1) comes off an average effort last start when seventh at this track over 300m behind Daring Bandit (17.07) in a Grade 5. Was in the money the start prior. Has ability and is one of the better chances. OUR MISS MAGGIE (2) was out of the placings last time when eighth at this track (17.27) but scored four back at The Meadows (30.38). Should be thereabouts. DIM SIM RIXI (8) has top-three aspirations after placing here over this journey last time.
